title: Market Run, Week 5
dek: Kyle Monangai took Chicago's backfield with 30 carries, and he is the first claim of the week.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Wed 4:20 PM ET: Zac Taylor calls Tee Higgins day to day, so Dohnte Meyers' window is Week 5 @MIA for sure and longer only if Higgins misses practice; the claim stays 8 to 15 percent.

Updated Wed 11:15 AM ET: rest-of-season ranks refreshed. Romeo Doubs is WR46, Brenton Strange TE16 and Juwan Johnson TE12; every call stands.

Updated Tue 6:20 PM ET: Seattle passed on Joe Mixon after his physical, so Emanuel Wilson's claim stays at 10 to 15 percent and Zach Charbonnet is the only back worth stashing behind him.

Updated Tue 5:10 PM ET: Zach Charbonnet is ruled out vs SF, so Emanuel Wilson has the whole Seattle backfield for one more week; claim him, 10 to 15 percent. Washington plans to have Jayden Daniels back as the starter vs NYG, so Kirk Cousins is a stream only for Lamar Jackson managers and bye weeks. Tyquan Thornton needs ankle surgery and misses 12 to 16 weeks.

Updated Tue 12:15 PM ET: Saquon Barkley is week to week and almost certainly out in London, so Will Shipley is the lead back and his claim goes up to 10 to 15 percent. Lamar Jackson has only an outside chance to play @ATL; Tyler Huntley's superflex stash goes up to 6 to 10 percent.

Four contenders lost a starter in Week 4, and the shop is full of running backs again. Chicago, Seattle, Philadelphia and Arizona all have a new name taking work. Two receivers stepped into Cincinnati's and Buffalo's injuries behind them.

Pass on Austin Ekeler (WAS): he played 17 snaps, 27 percent, with 5 touches in his first game, and Rachaad White's shoulder is the only reason he played that many. Leave him on waivers.

FAAB ranges are percent of a 100 budget, written for 10 to 14 team leagues in full PPR. Kansas City and Carolina are on bye. Rostered figures are from public waiver pages Tuesday morning; a blank means no clean number was available.
outro_md: The Menu lands Wednesday with every one of these players ranked for Week 5. Claims first, lineups after.

adds.why: Monangai ran 30 times for 146 yards and 2 TDs vs NYJ after D'Andre Swift lost a fumble at his own 28 in the third quarter and never came back; Chicago ran 49 times and held the ball for 42:45. The thumb he hurt in the fourth showed nothing concerning on imaging, and Ben Johnson called him day to day and fine for GB.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB. He is the Chicago back to own @GB until Swift wins carries back.

adds.why: Meyers caught 7 for 82 vs JAX after Ja'Marr Chase left with a concussion in the second quarter. Tee Higgins strained his adductor on the final drive, and Zac Taylor calls him day to day; Andrei Iosivas is on IR, so Meyers is the next outside receiver for a quarterback who just threw 54 times.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 8 to 15 percent of FAAB. The window is Week 5 @MIA with Chase in the protocol, and longer if Higgins misses practice this week.

adds.why: Wilson ran 21 times for 81 and a TD vs LAC and caught 3 for 39 and a second TD on a screen, with Jadarian Price on IR. Mike Macdonald said Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play vs SF, and Seattle passed on Joe Mixon after his physical, so the Week 5 lead is Wilson's for certain. The clock on his job starts in Week 6.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB. The whole job is his vs SF; Charbonnet's return in Week 6 or later ends it.

adds.why: Shipley played 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR and finished as Philadelphia's only healthy back. Tank Bigsby needs core muscle surgery and goes to IR for about six weeks, and Saquon Barkley is week to week with the hamstring, which almost certainly keeps him out vs JAX in London.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB. He is the lead back in London and Barkley's only backup for six weeks.

adds.why: Mitchell touched the ball 15 times @SEA (10 carries for 39, 5 catches for 24) to Omarion Hampton's 9, a week after 8 carries for 52 on 38 percent of the snaps. Hampton scored, but the touches have gone Mitchell's way two weeks running.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB. He holds half of the work vs DEN, and the passing-down half in PPR.

adds.why: Coleman played 46 of 59 snaps and ran a route on 31 of 40 dropbacks vs NE, catching 6 of 7 for 116 and a TD after DJ Moore left with the shoulder. Moore is day to day with the same AC joint he hurt in Week 2.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. If Moore sits @LAR Monday night, Coleman is a flex play.

adds.why: Allgeier ran 8 times for 42 and a TD @NYG and took 3 of 5 goal-line snaps in Week 3. Mike LaFleur said Jeremiyah Love tweaked his other ankle, and Love said the staff is managing his workload.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. He gets the short scores vs DET while Love's ankles are managed.

adds.why: Concepcion played 59 snaps (92 percent) vs PIT and led Cleveland with 8 targets, catching 5 for 64, career highs in both. His average target comes 1.8 yards downfield, so he needs the volume to pay off.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB. WR41 rest of season for me, a bench receiver with a full-time role.

adds.why: Cooper played 55 of 61 snaps vs LAR and led Philadelphia with 7 targets, catching 3 for 33 and 2 TDs. DeVonta Smith is out two to three games, so the role holds through London.
adds.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. A deep-league flex @JAX while Smith is out.

adds.why: Doubs caught 2 TDs @BUF with A.J. Brown on IR until Week 6 at the earliest, and Mack Hollins left in the third quarter with the calf. Hollins led New England with 16 targets through three games, so his practice status decides Doubs' share.
adds.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. WR46 rest of season for me; play him vs LV only if Hollins sits.

adds.why: Cousins threw for 365 yards, 2 TDs and 1 pick vs KC and has multiple touchdown passes in three straight games. Brock Bowers is back to 11 targets and Michael Mayer added 10. Dan Quinn said Washington plans to have Jayden Daniels back as the starter vs NYG after a full week of practice on the elbow.
adds.verdict: Stream him @NE, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB, if your quarterback is Lamar Jackson or on a bye. Daniels managers wait for Friday's injury report before they claim him.

adds.why: Strange caught 7 for 95 on a team-high 8 targets @CIN, season highs in catches and yards.
adds.verdict: Stream him vs PHI in London, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. TE16 rest of season for me, a one-week tight end.

stashes.why: Charbonnet's practice window off PUP opened Oct 1 after last season's knee injury, and Mike Macdonald ruled him out for Week 5 vs SF, so Week 6 is the earliest he plays. Price is on IR, and Seattle passed on Joe Mixon after his physical and signed Robert Henry Jr. instead.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. He is the back who takes over from Wilson.

stashes.why: Hill's agent said Monday he could sign in the next few days, and Kansas City, without Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton, is one of the teams talking to him. He is coming back from the dislocated knee and torn ACL from Week 4 of 2025, and the target is November. He is on 22 percent of rosters.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB, if you have a bench spot to wait a month.

stashes.why: Huntley is the backup behind Lamar Jackson, whose sprained left ankle gives him only an outside chance to play @ATL Sunday night, per NFL Network, and could cost more than one game. Huntley went 8 of 9 for 63 in relief vs TEN.
stashes.verdict: Stash him in superflex, 6 to 10 percent of FAAB. One-QB leagues pass.

stashes.why: Harvey caught 10 for 68 @SF, career highs, while J.K. Dobbins played 42 percent of the snaps. Pat Bryant was carted off in the same game, and the short throws went to Harvey.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. He is a PPR flex the week Dobbins misses time.

stashes.why: Robinson ran for 62 yards and three touchdowns at NO Monday night, all from close range, behind Bijan Robinson's 145 and two.
stashes.verdict: Stash him in 14-team leagues only, 0 to 1 percent of FAAB. He is a touchdown handcuff.

drops.why: Core muscle surgery and IR for about six weeks.
drops.verdict: Drop him for any add on this list.

drops.why: He re-sprained the right MCL in London and misses multiple weeks, and Dan Quinn said Washington plans to have Jayden Daniels back as the starter vs NYG.
He dislocated his left ankle @LV after catching 5 for 111 and 2 TDs, tore ligaments and needs surgery that will cost him 12 to 16 weeks, with a postseason return possible. Kansas City is also on bye.
drops.verdict: Drop him unless you have an open IR spot.

drops.why: Nico Collins came back to 69 percent of the snaps and caught 7 for 118 and 2 TDs vs DAL. The Weeks 2 and 3 targets go back to Collins.

mnf.text: Atlanta ran for five touchdowns in a 45-24 win at NO. Bijan Robinson ran for 145 and two scores, Brian Robinson Jr. took three from close range, and Michael Penix Jr. was 15 of 20 for 223. Stash Brian Robinson Jr. in 14-team leagues only, 0 to 1 percent of FAAB.

Alvin Kamara (NO) scored from 3 and 5 yards out, and Juwan Johnson (NO) caught 6 for 59 with Noah Fant inactive. Johnson is TE12 rest of season for me; hold him. Kamara stays in lineups as a flex while Travis Etienne Jr. is out; hold him.
